fullPassage: Pre-emption means that a strategy is designed to prevent a rival from starting some particular activity. In some case a pre-emptive move may simply be an announcement of some intent that might discourage rivals from doing the same. The idea of pre-emption implies that timing is sometimes very important — a decision or an action at one point in time might be much more rewarding than doing it at a different time point. Pre-emption may involve up-weighting advertising for a period before and during when a new entrant launches into a market. The intent is to make it more difficult for the new entrant's advertising to make an impression on potential buyers. Product proliferation is another potential pre-emption strategy. The general idea is to launch a large variety of product variants so that there is very little in the way of market demand that are not accommodated. Arguably, if a market is already filled with product variants it is more difficult for competitors to find untapped pockets of market demand.

det.tip: rewarding(보람/가치 있는) ↔ wasteful(낭비적인) = fruitless(결실 없는)

questions.passage: Pre-emption means that a strategy is designed to prevent a rival from starting some particular activity. In some case a pre-emptive move may simply be an announcement of some intent that might discourage rivals from doing the same. The idea of pre-emption implies that timing is sometimes very important — a decision or an action at one point in time might be much more rewarding than doing it at a different time point. Pre-emption may involve up-weighting advertising for a period before and during when a new entrant launches into a market. The intent is to make it more difficult for the new entrant's advertising to make an impression on potential buyers. Product proliferation is another potential pre-emption strategy. The general idea is to launch a large variety of product variants so that there is very little in the way of market demand that are not accommodated. Arguably, if a market is already filled with product variants it is more difficult for competitors to find <u>untapped</u> pockets of market demand.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 untapped와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: untapped(미개척의/아직 활용되지 않은) ↔ exhausted(고갈된/이미 다 쓴)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ exhausted: untapped(아직 활용되지 않은)의 반의어. '이미 다 사용되어 고갈된' 상태 ←정답
❌ ① unexplored(탐험되지 않은): untapped와 유사 의미
❌ ② undiscovered(발견되지 않은): untapped와 유사 의미
❌ ③ unreached(도달되지 않은): untapped와 유사 의미
det.tip: untapped(미개척의) ↔ exhausted(고갈된/이미 다 활용된). tap(활용하다) — un-(부정접두사)로 구성

(B) The sculptor carefully shaped the clay to create a perfect <u>impression</u> of the ancient coin.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 impression의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) impression = 영향/인상(심리적), (B) impression = 본뜬 자국/찍은 형태(물리적)
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 영향/인상 — (B) 본뜬 자국/찍은 형태: (A)는 광고가 구매자에게 미치는 심리적 '영향'이나 '인상', (B)는 동전 형태를 점토에 눌러 만든 물리적 '자국' ←정답
❌ ① (A) 인상/흔적 — (B) 영향: (A)(B)의 구체적 의미가 올바르게 연결되지 않음
❌ ③ (A) 본뜬 자국 — (B) 영향: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ④ (A) 영향 — (B) 영향: (B)는 물리적 자국이지 심리적 영향이 아님
det.tip: impression: ① 인상/영향(추상적, 심리적) ② 찍힌 자국/본(물리적). 문맥으로 구분 필수
